headline: MPR Sets December 9 Date For Presidential Request On Vice President
seoTitle: MPR Postpones Vice President Election To December 9
metaDescription: The People's Consultative Assembly of Indonesia has rescheduled the plenary session for the new Vice President election to December 9, 2026.
aiSummaryBullets: The MPR has rescheduled the plenary session for the new Vice President election to December 9, 2026.
The change in date follows a formal request submitted by President Prabowo Subianto to the assembly.
The session aims to fill the current vacancy in the Vice President office following the departure of Gibran Rakabuming.
aiContextParagraph: The People's Consultative Assembly of the Republic of Indonesia (MPR RI) has officially confirmed a delay in the plenary session intended to select a new Vice President. Originally scheduled for December 2, 2026, the selection process will now occur on December 9, 2026. According to MPR Chairman Ahmad Muzani, this adjustment was made in direct response to a request from President Prabowo Subianto. The assembly held a series of meetings, including a joint meeting of its leadership, to deliberate on the shift in the parliamentary timeline to ensure the vacancy left by the previous official is appropriately addressed. While the MPR focuses on the electoral process, the national legislature, specifically the House of Representatives (DPR RI) Commission III, has concurrently conducted deliberations regarding new legislative proposals, including a bill on surveillance regulations intended to prevent potential misuse.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained significant traction across five independent outlets with high coverage velocity as the nation prepares to fill a key executive leadership position.
